messages:
tom: Noticed weird token stitching in orion-lite:int4 on the multilingual subtitle eval. Zero-width space (U+200B) sometimes becomes a visible space or drops a character next to hanzi. BLEU drops ~3 on the subtitle set. Repro command: `./evals/run.py --suite locale/subtitles-cjk --model orion-lite --quant int4 --seed 13`

ci-bot: CI artifact: /ci/artifacts/2955551234/summary.json (regressions: BLEU -3, chrF -2.1)

rachel: Reproed locally. FP16 output unchanged. The int4 decoder occasionally outputs an extra ASCII space where there was a ZWSP between hanzi and latin, shifting alignment. Happens with KVCACHE enabled and when request has short prefix cache hits.

sung: Can you paste a tiny failing example?

tom: Example:
```
# src: "\u4e2d\u6587\u200bEnglish\u8a9e"
# gold: "\u4e2d\u6587\u200bEnglish\u8a9e"
# fp16: "\u4e2d\u6587\u200bEnglish\u8a9e"
# int4: "\u4e2d\u6587 English\u8a9e"  <-- ZWSP turned into visible space, losing glue
```

priya: Hypothesis: kvcache stitching logic concatenates token spans and runs a canonicalize pass that treats invisible separators differently under int4 decode kernels. Another possibility: rounding noise in logits causes token boundary to shift and detok merges with whitespace.

rachel: Quick experiment: rerun int4 eval with `--kvcache false` and `--batch 1`. Early result: with kvcache disabled the problem disappears for these examples. So likely cache merge interaction.

sung: Good find. Suggested mitigation: disable kvcache for locale routes with zero-width chars until patch. We can also add `detok.keep_invisible=true` flag per-route.

tom: I'll open a PR with a unit test (example above) and a short-term routing change for affected customers. Also running kernel bisect: `scripts/bisect_kvcache.sh --model orion-lite --quant int4 --range cache-v1..cache-v3`

priya: I'll instrument the kvcache stitcher to log pre/post token boundaries and dump raw token ids for failing requests. If it's a kernel remap we'll need a tiny fix in the stitcher.

rachel: Label PR `customer-impact` if we flip routing. I'll notify support. We'll follow up with root cause once bisect/trace logs are in. :thumbsup:
